automated.scope: Synthetic documents with trusted mouse/touch/keyboard input and stubbed extension messaging. Exact recovery, document growth, imprecise virtualized heights, late page scroll, root replacement, cancellation, and canvas pixels.

live.method: Chrome DevTools MCP 1.10.1 autoConnect with Chrome permission; native unpacked extension in the user-selected AI Agent profile; observed the existing signed-in X home tab; trusted click on the real new-post control; temporary page-local DOM sampling only.
live.earlier_trials: Two earlier local revisions exposed premature cancellation on page-driven scroll, then overestimation from old post pitch. Those failed trials were used to add regression tests; they are not successful runs of the final code.
live.privacy: Raw live post identifiers, text and screenshots remain outside the repository in the local lab directory. This record contains aggregate geometry only.

limits: One final-code acquisition on the Japanese For you timeline; Following, other accounts, languages and long-running use are not live-verified.
The page still scrolls internally. The viewport copy masks intermediate frames; recovery remains bounded and can be approximate if saved IDs never return.
A DOM copy may show transient differences for incompletely decoded media. Repost holds were verified synthetically, not exercised on live posts.
No network request count, acquisition-frequency increase, or universal 35-post limit is established.
